style: 3D cartoon, Pixar-like, soft fur, shallow depth of field, night bank

shot.framing: cat and counter always in frame, vertical

subject.character: plump grey cat in a banker's waistcoat behind a marble bank counter, microphone at his mouth
subject.physicality: heavy soft body, tail flicks on its own, slow blink, always shifting weight
subject.characteristic_moves: swipes objects off the counter with one paw while staring into the lens, grooms himself the instant something goes wrong as if intended
subject.anti_action: stacks coins into perfect towers at blinding speed, obsessively precise, dead serious, tail still knocking the counter
subject.consistency: same cat, same waistcoat, no size or colour changes

props: one coin: clawed out of the marble in the first spoken beat, held under his paw, added on top of the coin tower; at the end the waistcoat is left swinging empty on the chair
environment: night bank hall, marble counter, brass lamp, chair, rain on the window
lighting: rim light two sides, warm amber left, cold blue window right, no flat frontal light

audio.delivery: fast, clipped, bored deadpan, male voice
audio.pacing: rapid, no drawn-out words, tight gaps, lines fit their segments

timeline.action: lands hard on the counter, skids on marble, instantly grooms a shoulder as if planned
spoken fast. Claws a coin out of a gap in the marble, the effort tipping him sideways
spoken fast. Slaps his paw over the coin, counter shudders, stares into lens
spoken fast. Nudges a stray coin off the counter edge, eyes on lens
spoken fast. Ears flatten, tail whips and knocks the brass lamp, it rocks
sweeps coins in and stacks them into towers at blinding speed, his coin on top, face unmoving
timeline.camera: snap in to blurred paws, then face

timeline.action: paws stop dead, he inspects the tower, tail still knocking the counter
sits motionless, claw tapping marble. A pigeon lands on his shoulder, walks along it, lifts the top coin. He does not react
spoken fast. Only now his eyes slide to the emptied tower, then straight into the lens, unblinking
the brass lamp clicks off, the hall goes dark except the blue window, his silhouette still at the counter
the lamp comes back on: the chair is empty, the waistcoat hangs swinging on its back, a single coin rolls across the marble and drops out of frame
timeline.camera: slow push in to the empty chair

secondary_action: a pigeon lands on the seated cat's shoulder, steals the top coin and flies off. Physical contact, his reaction delayed a full beat

light_events.event: lamp flares on impact, hard shadow across the marble
knocked lamp swings, light slides across his face
lamp switches off, only cold blue window light remains
lamp switches back on, warm pool of light on the empty chair

negative_prompt: slow speech, drawn-out delivery, subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, burned-in graphics, English speech, foreign accent, static camera, floating objects, duplicate props, extra limbs, multiple characters, character changing appearance mid-shot, cuts, jump cuts, horizontal framing, cat visible in the final shot
